description: Add indexes on the tables behind traffic_combined so the admin traffic viewer no longer full-scans on load
notes: traffic_combined is a VIEW (dns_traffic_view UNION ALL nat_sessions_enriched), so it cannot be indexed directly. These indexes are on the base tables the view reads. All statements use IF NOT EXISTS / IF EXISTS so the migration is safe on installs that already have them. The accompanying traffic.py change (no CAST, statement_timeout on the count) is what stops the 504; these indexes make the remaining scan cheaper.
